questions.question: Should the deck window be hard-capped in height (and the tall 'grid' layout removed), or stay free to grow tall on big displays?

options.label: Cap height, drop grid (Recommended)
options.description: Window resizes freely in width but height is clamped to roughly 270–540 pt — it can never become a tall window. The grid layout (which only activates at ≥760 pt height and wraps cards to multiple rows) is deleted; the deck is always a strip.

options.label: Cap height, keep grid
options.description: Same height clamp, but the grid code path stays for a possible future tall mode. Dead code on the strip, and the two-row wrap you screenshotted stays reachable if the cap is ever lifted.

options.label: No cap, keep grid
options.description: Leave the window free; rely on you sizing it. The strip layout stays one of three modes rather than the product's shape.

questions.question: When a question arrives carrying ASCII mockup previews, where should it render on the strip?

options.label: Full-strip takeover (Recommended)
options.description: Preview-carrying questions temporarily own the whole strip — exactly like the terminal, where the dialog owns the screen. Options column left, mockup gets ~1300 pt of width. Cards return the moment you answer or dismiss.
options.preview:
┌────────────────────── 1920 × 480 ───────────────────────┐
│ ? Preview UI — workspace/openagentdeck              [Esc ✕] │
│ Which header layout?                                        │
│                                                             │
│ ◉ 1. Compact     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐ │
│ ○ 2. Tall        │                                       │ │
│ ○ 3. Split       │   ASCII mockup — full width,          │ │
│                  │   no clipping, follows selection      │ │
│ [ Other… ]      └─────────────────────────────────┘ │
└────────────── cards hidden while it is open ────────────┘

options.label: Stay in the inspector
options.description: The question stays in the right-hand inspector column (380–760 pt) with a side-by-side layout inside it; cards remain visible but the mockup pane is ~300 pt and scrolls horizontally.

questions.question: The titlebar currently spends ~52 pt on the title, session count, and usage readout. How much should we reclaim?

options.label: Compact system titlebar (Recommended)
options.description: Switch to the unified-compact toolbar style — one ~38 pt row, keeps native traffic lights, drag, and toolbar behaviors. Cheap, safe, reversible.

options.label: Hide titlebar, custom header
options.description: Hidden-titlebar window with our own strip header drawn into the content edge. Maximum height reclaimed (~10–15 pt more than compact), but we own drag regions, traffic-light placement, and fullscreen quirks.

options.label: Leave chrome as is
options.description: Keep the current titlebar; spend the height budget elsewhere.
